//: Budgets catch a suite or shard getting materially slower, not ordinary runner variance. Update the description with measured evidence whenever the test topology changes.

backend-unit-tests.description: Per backend unit shard (backup suites run in backend-pbt shard 1). The two shards keep the integration-heavy unit surface below this budget while preserving per-worker SQLite isolation.

backend-pbt-shard.description: Backend PBT shard (FAST_CHECK_NUM_RUNS=15). Shard 1 also runs the serial backup suites and dominates: observed 2026-09-14 min 64s, median 75s, max 122s, plus a 200s failure on a slow runner with all 404 tests passing. Shards 2/3 median 38s/46s. Raised 150s -> 210s.

frontend-tests.description: Frontend Vitest suite (isolated fork pool with 4 CI workers). The budget still leaves headroom for runner variance; file-isolation is required because --no-isolate breaks shared module mocks.
